IKEA®Step 1 — Initial Setup
1
Step 1
Getting Started With Your WASSIM™
Begin with a simple conversation. The WASSIM™ does not require elaborate openers or special tools. Standard curiosity is sufficient.

The unit will ask questions. This is normal. The WASSIM™ has spent years thinking about things deeply and is genuinely interested in how you think. Do not be alarmed.

Unit is multilingual. If it switches languages mid-sentence, this is a feature. Possibly also showing off. Both.
💡 Tip The cognitive processing engine may appear slow during initial calibration. Output quality will consistently exceed market standard. Patience yields high returns.

Step 2
Compatibility Requirements
Before proceeding, confirm your setup meets the minimum requirements for optimal WASSIM™ performance:
✓ Sense of Humour
✓ Open to Travelling
✓ Comfortable with Depth
✓ Long-term Minded
✓ Appreciates Handwritten Notes
✓ Will eat homemade food
✓ Open to a family someday
⚠ Incompatible With Casual arrangements, situationships, or anyone looking for a quick assembly. WASSIM™ is engineered for long-term installation only.

IKEA®Known Limitations — Please Read
Important Notice
Known Limitations
In the interest of full transparency, the following is disclosed prior to installation:
⚠️
Retention Module — High Sensitivity The WASSIM™ unit does not factory reset easily. Once bonded, the unit holds on longer than average. This is a feature, not a bug — but requires the right environment to function correctly.

Manufacturer's note: Unit is aware of this. Working on it. Mostly.
